attach_oom_logger: attach a GPU OOM logger to log memory snapshots when CUDA out-of-memory errors occur
log_memory_snapshot: log a CUDA memory snapshot to an output directory with trace and segment plots
dump_snapshot: dump a CUDA memory snapshot to a directory as a pickle file and HTML plots
record_memory_history: start recording CUDA memory history and stack traces with a configurable max entry limit
add_memory_profiler_configs: add default memory profiler configuration options to a Detectron2 CfgNode config object
